rule.name: MAUI Insecure HTTP Endpoint Usage
rule.rule_desc: Detects cleartext endpoint references in .NET MAUI applications.
rule.vuln_desc: Cleartext transport can expose sensitive mobile traffic to interception and tampering.
rule.developer: Use HTTPS endpoints only and keep strict certificate validation enabled.
rule.reviewer: Audit endpoint constants and networking client setup. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: MAUI Certificate Validation Bypass
rule.rule_desc: Detects TLS certificate validation bypass patterns in .NET MAUI networking code.
rule.vuln_desc: Certificate validation bypass enables man-in-the-middle interception attacks.
rule.developer: Remove trust-bypass callbacks and rely on strict system validation or correct pinning.
rule.reviewer: Verify no callback unconditionally accepts invalid certificates. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: MAUI WebView Script Bridge Marker
rule.rule_desc: Detects MAUI embedded web view and script execution paths requiring trust-boundary review.
rule.vuln_desc: Unsafe embedded browser usage can expose native capabilities to untrusted content.
rule.developer: Restrict content origins and minimize script/native bridge exposure.
rule.reviewer: Review webview source restrictions and script execution paths. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: MAUI Unvalidated URL Opening
rule.rule_desc: Detects .NET MAUI Launcher/Browser API calls that open a URL without visible validation.
rule.vuln_desc: Opening an externally-influenced URL without validation can enable open-redirect or unsafe scheme/deep-link abuse.
rule.developer: Validate the target URL's scheme and origin against an allow-list before calling OpenAsync.
rule.reviewer: Trace the URL argument's origin. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
